Payroll Intelligence Center

Real-time salary analytics & compliance

Salary Structure Rules

1. Basic Salary Scale
Allocated as **50% of the employee's gross monthly salary**. Formulates the foundation for PF, gratuity, and basic tax slabs.
2. House Rent Allowance (HRA)
Calculated as **40% of the Basic salary scale**. HRA is fully exempt from tax calculations under statutory rental ceilings.
3. Provident Fund (PF)
Employee contribution is **12% of the Basic salary scale**, deducted automatically at disbursal and filed to the EPFO monthly.
4. ESI Contribution
Employee insurance is calculated as **0.75% of Gross salary**, providing health coverage under state statutory welfare codes.
5. Professional Tax (PT)
Flat deduction of **₹200 / month** mandated under the municipal professional, trade, and callings tax structure.
